flows.name: Resolve a safe ingestion destination
steps: Load active projects and attribution signals
Reject archived or unavailable project targets
Convert mapped internal-container projects to one Business Area target
Apply the Graph ingestion confidence threshold
flows.expectedOutcome: A record resolves to one project, one Business Area, or no target; it never resolves to an archived project or both target types

claims.description: Archived projects are excluded across project, rule, contact, and cached-signal paths
Typed assignment returns a project or Business Area but never both
All five live container-project mappings match the approved Brain branches
The shared Microsoft Graph adapter preserves typed targets, thresholds low-confidence results, and fails closed on mapping errors
